description: Defines the MatcherValidationEvent class for validating matcher data within the Goteo application, including scoring and error handling for profile, overview, criteria, and configuration.

classes.name: MatcherValidationEvent
classes.description: Handles validation and scoring of matcher data, including profile, overview, criteria, and configuration scores, and tracks errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with a Matcher object and resets scores and errors.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets scores, errors, and fields to initial state.

methods.name: setKeys
methods.description: Sets the keys used for scoring and validation.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the current set of keys.

methods.name: setFields
methods.description: Sets the form fields with errors.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the form fields with errors.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates scores for each key and overall global score.

methods.name: getProfileScore
methods.description: Calculates profile completeness score and errors.

methods.name: getOverviewScore
methods.description: Calculates overview completeness score and errors.

methods.name: getCriteriaScore
methods.description: Calculates criteria score based on questionnaire presence.

methods.name: getConfigurationScore
methods.description: Calculates configuration score based on matcher variables.
